summary: The dark theme layout exhibits contrast and state-tracking defects, including unreadable text in the baseline section, missing selected date styling in the calendar, and premature completion actions in the questionnaire flow.

issues.title: Low contrast body text
issues.description: Surrounding inline text within the card fails contrast standards on dark backgrounds.
issues.evidence: Body text such as 'Rates read from' and 'applied at checkout' blends into the dark surface.
issues.suggestion: Apply higher-contrast muted text tokens for dark theme body copy.

issues.title: Missing active date indicator
issues.description: The calendar grid does not visually indicate the selected date.
issues.evidence: Footer text indicates Jan 12, 2026 is selected, but date cell 12 uses default unselected styling.
issues.suggestion: Add active selection styling to the active CalendarDayButton.

issues.title: Premature completion action
issues.description: Final submission action is displayed on the initial step.
issues.evidence: Both 'Next' and 'Lock in pricing' buttons are visible on Question 1 of 3.
issues.suggestion: Render only step-appropriate navigation buttons until the final question.
